key.name: cast-mode
key.description: Whether a new cast mirrors an existing screen or extends the desktop onto the receiver with a virtual monitor. Extend requires a desktop that offers the portal's VIRTUAL source type.

key.name: cast-extend-position
key.description: Where to place the virtual monitor relative to the existing screens when extending onto a receiver.

key.name: cast-display-only
key.summary: Turn off this computer's screens while extending
key.description: The equivalent of "Second screen only": extend onto the receiver, then disable the physical monitors. Always confirmed with a timed dialog that reverts if there is no answer.

key.name: cast-max-height
key.description: Caps the streamed resolution. 0 lets the helper choose: 1080 with a hardware encoder, 720 without one, because 1080p software encode costs more than a full CPU core.

key.name: cast-fps
key.description: Frames per second to encode. The keyframe interval follows this, so a receiver joining late waits at most one second.

key.name: cast-bitrate-kbps
key.description: 0 picks a default from the resolution: 6000 kbps at 1080p, 4000 kbps at 720p.

key.name: cast-audio
key.description: Capture the default output and mux AAC alongside the video. Requires an AAC encoder; the helper reports whether one is present.

key.name: cast-mute-local
key.description: Mute the local output for the duration of the cast so sound only comes from the receiver, then restore it.

key.name: cast-audio-delay-ms
key.description: Manual A/V offset, for receivers that buffer audio and video differently. Positive values delay the audio.

key.name: cast-port-min
key.description: Lowest TCP port the stream server may bind. A fixed range is what makes a firewall rule possible.

key.name: cast-port-max
key.description: Highest TCP port the stream server may bind.

key.name: cast-auto-presentation
key.description: While a cast is running, inhibit idle and blanking and hide notification banners. Derived from the helper's state, so it turns itself off when the cast stops.

key.name: cast-show-speakers
key.description: List speakers and speaker groups in the device list. They cannot show a screen, so they are hidden by default.

key.name: cast-last-devices
key.summary: Receivers the last cast went to
key.description: Written when a cast starts, so clicking the tile resumes to the same receivers without opening the picker. Ids are never pruned on write a television that is switched off should still be remembered tomorrow and are resolved against discovery at click time, so a receiver that is no longer there opens the picker instead.

key.name: open-cast-menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Cast Display dialog, without needing Quick Settings to be open first.

key.name: monitor-groups
key.description: JSON map of connector name to group letter (A, B, C, …) used for custom multi-monitor layouts.
